track.title: A path written across two worlds.

milestones.title: Group Purchasing Director
milestones.body: Across several larger corporations: Harmonize, Standardize, Globalize. International career across the Automotive, Home Appliances, Housing and Boating industries.

milestones.title: Build Best Supplier Panels & Resilient Supply chains
milestones.body: Manage cross-cultural negotiations. Promote processes to cut cost, enhance quality, mitigate risk, shorten lead times — sustainably.

milestones.title: British & Chinese universities
milestones.body: French Mediterranean upbringing. British & Chinese education — the origin of a genuinely bilingual, bicultural sourcing practice.

thesis.title: The edge is no longer the data.
thesis.intro: Everyone now has the algorithms. What separates outcomes is the ability to move fluently between systems, cultures and people — turning analysis into agreements that last.

columns.title: AI-enhanced data crunching
columns.body: Spend analytics, supplier scorecards, cost breakdowns & total-cost of ownership modelling, risk mapping. Data sharpens the questions and exposes the leverage.

columns.title: Human relationships prevail
columns.body: Trust built across cultures and time zones, on the spot negotiation skills, commitments that hold when the spreadsheet can't see around the corner.

fluency.title: Four languages.
fluency.intro1: Fluency is not a line on a CV — it is the ability to hear what a supplier actually means, to close in their language, and to keep a relationship alive long after the contract signature.
fluency.intro2: Educated across British and Chinese universities, working seamlessly between West and East.

langs.name: French
